cohort: The study cohort consisted of 500 neonates and their mothers whose electronic and printed medical records were reviewed.
finding: ABO incompatibility, G6PD deficiency, and older maternal age (>25 years) were identified as the commonest neonatal and maternal risk factors for developing neonatal indirect hyperbilirubinemia.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was found to be a maternal risk factor for neonatal indirect hyperbilirubinemia in 32% of mothers.
